title: Lovely Earthy Greek Burrata Stifado
description: A creamy and earthy Greek dish featuring burrata, with a nostalgic twist, this stifado is a perfect combination of flavors and textures, with an ayurvedic-rajasic friendly approach.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the red wine, bay leaves, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Cut the burrata cheese into small pieces and add it to the saucepan, stirring gently to combine.
Continue to simmer the stifado for an additional 5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the sauce is creamy.
Serve the stifado hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
